title: Vivino Rating Drift on Owned Bottles
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vivino:wine wine_id=* vivino_rating=*
| sort wine_id _time
| streamstats current=f last(vivino_rating) as prior_rating by wine_id
| eval rating_delta=round(vivino_rating-prior_rating,2)
| where abs(rating_delta)>=0.5
| table wine_name vivino_rating prior_rating rating_delta
description: Detects Vivino community rating shifts of half a point or more on wines you own.
value: Community rating drift can signal vintage variation or emerging quality issues before you open a case.
implementation: Rescan owned wines periodically and compare `vivino_rating` against prior snapshots by `wine_id`.
visualization: Table of wines with rating delta.
grandmaExplanation: It spots wines in your collection whose Vivino scores moved noticeably since you last checked.
